ledger.x: c. 1665: the Mwane-a-Yamvu title is created and the Lunda kingdom begins. 'Their son became the first paramount ruler and created the title Mwane-a-Yamvu (c. 1665).' Other sources make Nawej, ruling 'about 1695', the first well-attested ruler; the Early Congolese history page has Mwata Yamvo 'ruler from 1660 to 1665'.…
1720s: under Yava a Nawej the Lunda expand west across the Kasai River; the Lulua resisted.

wars.name: Chokwe invasion of the Lunda kingdom
wars.outcome: The Chokwe, armed with guns, invaded and overthrew the Lunda kingdom; the infobox ends the kingdom in 1887.

wars.name: Lunda-Kanyok war (Nawej and Muland)
wars.outcome: Nawej was killed by Kanyok forces, who built a fortress in Lunda territory; Muland drove them out.

certainty.note: A confederation of chieftainships paying tribute, with no surveyed frontier; the pages give areas, not boundaries.
